# Apka Bill

> Apka Bill is simple billing software for shop owners in India. Tap the items, take the payment, hand over the bill. It works on an Android phone, a tablet or a computer, and keeps working without internet.

## Who it is for
Kirana and grocery shops, general stores, mobile and electronics shops, clothing shops, restaurants and cafes.

## What it does
- GST bills in a few taps: search by name, SKU or barcode
- Cash, UPI, card or credit; partial payments keep the balance as due
- UPI QR on the bill, so the customer pays the exact amount
- Bills shared on WhatsApp
- 58mm thermal printing with logo, UPI QR and barcode
- Offline billing; bills sync when the internet returns
- Stock that updates with every sale and purchase, with low-stock alerts
- Customer dues (khata), suppliers and purchases
- Daily sales, profit and expense reports, with PDF and Excel export
- Several stores under one account
- Kitchen tickets (KOT) for restaurants

## How to get it
Shop accounts are set up by the Apka Bill team. Contact on WhatsApp: +91 79822 72206 (https://wa.me/917982272206).
